summary: ADR-0113 made every correction directive ask for an appended ## Correction N section. The build remediation fix dispatch (cyclerun_remediate.go, 'REMEDIATION round %d') is the same class: a source-writing re-dispatch whose fix lives outside build-report.md. It is already covered by the worktree-evidence backstop (it carries a directive and WorktreeReadOnly=false), but only at the first idle checkpoint (1200 s).
